scenes.heading: Python For Loops: Iterating with range()
scenes.subtitle: Master how loops repeat actions step-by-step with clean execution
scenes.narration: Welcome! Today we will learn how Python for loops work step-by-step using the range function.
scenes.caption: Welcome! Today we will learn how Python for loops work step-by-step using the range function.

scenes.heading: Walking Through the Code
scenes.narration: Here is our loop: for i in range 3, we print the current iteration value. Watch how execution advances line by line.
scenes.caption: Here is our loop: for i in range(3), we print the current iteration value. Watch how execution advances line by line.
scenes.code:
# Python loop demonstration
for i in range(3):
    print("Iteration value:", i)
print("Loop completed!")

scenes.heading: Step-by-Step Iteration Flow
scenes.narration: In the first cycle, i is 0. In the second cycle, i becomes 1. Finally, i reaches 2 before the loop exits cleanly.
scenes.caption: In the first cycle, i is 0. In the second cycle, i becomes 1. Finally, i reaches 2 before the loop exits cleanly.
